facts.quote: Egg guarding primarily occurs through mutualism with the ants Lasius niger and Lasius alienus.

facts.text: Mravenci chrání vajíčka před predátory a parazity.
facts.quote: L. niger and L. alienus protect the eggs from predation and parasitism by other organisms.

facts.text: Housenky vylučují sladkou šťávu, kterou se živí mravenci.
facts.quote: In return, the ants feed on a saccharine secretion produced by glands on the larvae.

facts.text: Housenky se živí například jetelem a janovcem.
facts.quote: In early summer and autumn the larva feeds on plants such as Coronilla, Trifolium, Colutea, and Genista.

facts.text: Housenky tráví většinu dne v mraveništích.
facts.quote: Larvae usually spend the day in the nests of the ants.

facts.text: Dospělci žijí jen asi 4 až 5 dní.
facts.quote: The adult butterfly lives only for about 4-5 days
